title: Nest a child graph as an observable subgraph
narrative: Fangore embeds a child plan under a parent step. The child must run as its own graph execution with telemetry, not as an opaque nested model call. Accepts inspiration requirement 3[^insp-r03].
implementation: `SubgraphNodeRunner.embed` stores a child `ExecutionGraph` on a parent node; `GraphExecutor` runs nested graphs with linked run ids and emits graph lifecycle events for the child.
validation: Kind `dynamic_subgraph_nest`. Soft expects parent ok, child_status ok, nested graph events present.
